# Announcing the General Availability of the Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust!

## What Changed

The Azure Cosmos DB SDK for Rust is now generally available. It is a native client for Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL, built for production workloads, and it builds on the public preview we shipped earlier this year.
